payload.claim: The claim states the added text is `replace` with its `find` "taken out once," but never states that `find` occurs exactly once inside `replace`, only that `replace` "holds its `find` whole" (i.e., contains it). If `find` occurred more than once inside `replace`, which occurrence to split on is unstated. None of the seven refused, sixteen None, or wrong-version cases exercises this edge, so it costs nothing concretely against the witness, but the claim's own wording leaves it ambiguous.
